title: Fishing and horses
summary: Rosenberg asks if he fished back then; Bunn says no, though he sees fishing as a good way to occupy the mind.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Right. Did you ever go fishing? Like I know you ride horses now. I'm sure you didn't ride horses back then.
No, you didn't ride no horse back then. I went -- used to go -- did I go fishing? No, I never went fishing back then.
A lot of guitarists are into fishing. That's why I asked.
Yeah, I know it. I mean, that's a good thing.
It's a good thing. You can get away.
That's right. Takes over what's on your mind. Even though you won't catch a fish.
